# ClearID Audit Kft. — Terminal access review

ClearID Audit Kft. supplies terminal access audits for Project Bridge North. The agreement expires on 2027-02-28. Operations owns the review schedule. This agreement belongs to a separate legal entity from ClearID Kft.; its invoices use supplier code CA-17 and cover supervised warehouse access reviews rather than identity verification API calls.

The auditor inspects station permissions and checks that each temporary account has a recorded sponsor. A sample of completed training sessions is compared with the station log. The reviewer records an exception when the logged account cannot be connected to the person attending. An exception is assigned to the site coordinator for correction before the next audit session.

The site visit requires an escort and does not include unrestricted access to the dispatch floor. Interview notes should identify the station and shift without copying employee document images. The auditor can recommend that an account be closed, but the approved site access process performs the closure. Operations confirms the completion date and keeps the original exception reference.

The commercial schedule includes two visits and a short closing review. Cancelled appointments must be rearranged within the contract period. The supplier will not count a telephone discussion as a completed physical inspection. Procurement must approve additional travel charges before another visit is booked, even when the initial audit identified a legitimate concern.

The January review will examine whether supervisors can explain the account handover process without using shared credentials. The final report separates unresolved account exceptions from housekeeping observations such as unlabelled drawers. Operations will retain the approved report with its training records. Any extension beyond February requires a new written service decision.
